verdict.rationale: TaxJar's docs show nexus/threshold tracking, AutoFile for state remittance, and an archive of historical sales tax data, which support jurisdiction-level liability visibility and filing-ready reporting, but there is no explicit mention of a collected-vs-owed dashboard, real-time accrued liability view, or accountant/GL-formatted exports. missing for 10: explicit 'collected vs owed' liability reporting, real-time accrual view, and documented GL/accountant export formats.
